65602.name: What Is Love?
objectivesText: You can light the torch using a campfire. If you don't have the cooking skill (or mats), you can go to the campfire near Talen at 15,31. Once lit, toss the torch on to the Archaeologist's Cart.

79093.name: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

8554.name: Facing Negolash
objectivesText: This quest is repeatable, but can only be completed while you have the quest "Facing Negolash" in your quest log.

8619.name: Morndeep the Elder
objectivesText:
Located inside Blackrock Depths at the Ring of Law, accessed through the Detention Block. From the entrance walk straight forward across the big central floor into the facing cave, and the Ring of Law can be accessed on the immediate left. 

WARNING: Approaching the Elder will also start the encounter, but you can escape the way you came before the gate closes.

8635.name: Splitrock the Elder
objectivesText: Inside of Maraudon. Located in the passage way across the water where Rotgrip can be found as if you were headed to Tinkerer from the water near Princess.

8644.name: Stonefort the Elder
objectivesText: Located in Lower Blackrock Spire in Hordemar City. He can be found on the left as you cross the first wooden bridge.

8676.name: Wildmane the Elder
objectivesText: Inside of Zul'Farrak. Located by the pool where Gahz'rilla is summoned.

8678.name: Wheathoof the Elder [Wrath+] / Proudhorn the Elder [Classic]

8713.name: Starsong the Elder
objectivesText: Inside of Sunken Temple. From the entrance, take a left up the spiral staircase. You will need to fight and kill the first dragon pack. Continue down the hallway and hang left into the room with all the dragonkin and then again into the alcove.

8727.name: Farwhisper the Elder
objectivesText: Located inside of Stratholme in Festival Lane. Fastest route to him is from the Service Entrance and then head towards The Unforgiven on Live side.

8767.name: A Gently Shaken Gift [Non-Spell Casters Only] (Before 2015)
objectivesText: Given prior to 2015 exclusively to non-spell casters.

8788.name: A Gently Shaken Gift [Spell Casters Only] (Before 2015)
objectivesText: Given prior to 2015 exclusively to spell casters.

8827.name: Winter's Presents [A]
objectivesText: This quest becomes available after the 25th.

8828.name: Winter's Presents [H]
objectivesText: This quest becomes available after the 25th.

8860.name: New Year Celebrations! (Alliance)
objectivesText: This quest is only available on December 31. Quest can be obtained from Wonderform Operator in any major city.

8861.name: New Year Celebrations! (Horde)
objectivesText: This quest is only available on December 31. Quest can be obtained from Wonderform Operator in any major city.

8868.name: Elune's Blessing
objectivesText:
In order to summon Omen you need to fire 30 cluster rockets from the launcer at 63.73, 62.41. Any will do. The spawns Minion of Omen can be ignored.

Elune's Blessing is obtained from a ring of light appearing on Omen's corpse. The light does not disappear when the corpse despawns, so you might not need to fight Omen at all.

8883.name: Valadar Starsong
objectivesText:
Picking up this Quest from a Quest Giver makes it unavailable at another one.
It does not matter which one.
There is no need (or point) to visit all of them. You need only one.

8996.name: Return to Bodley
objectivesText:
If you did complete the quest before the Cataclysm, you can request a new Brazier from Bodley.
You must have the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer In order to see him outside UBRS Entrance in Black Rock Mountain.
Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan in Tanaris can assist you in getting the Ghost Revealer.

9015.name: The Challenge
objectivesText: Long after Classic is over, you can use this item to summon Unobtainable bosses and earn quite a bit of gold doing so for Transmog and other purposes. Save this item forever.

9323.name: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms

93463.name: Triggered when turning in 'The High Order', likely a shared quest flag for either faction having completed their initial introduction quest.

94375.name: Call of Earth (3/3)
objectivesText: You must keep this in your bags forever.
